gaps: webhook subscriptions need separate credentials: projects/{projectsId}/subscribers and subscriptions routes require a Google Cloud project and service identity distinct from the user OAuth flow, so they sit outside the default user-data read surface.

data-type sync fans out per type: Google Health exposes data points only under users/me/dataTypes/{type}/dataPoints, so a full sync issues one paginated request per data type; the default resource set is curated to the common metrics to keep a bare sync cheap.

API is newly launched (v4): The Google Health API replaced the Fitbit Web API in 2026 and is still stabilizing; field availability depends on the user's connected devices (Fitbit, Pixel Watch, third-party).

novel_features.name: Metric Trend Lines
novel_features.description: Per-metric trailing rolling-average trend lines with net first-to-last delta, de-noising day-to-day scale-weight and resting-HR whiplash
novel_features.rationale: No tool on the Google Health API computes trend lines; garmy/oura-cli offer this only for other vendors and Google's own SDKs return raw points

novel_features.name: Goal Streaks
novel_features.description: Current and longest consecutive-calendar-day streaks where a metric met a goal (e.g. 10k steps, resting HR under 60), with calendar gaps breaking the run
novel_features.rationale: Streak tracking over local history is absent from every verified Google Health tool and from Google's SDKs

novel_features.name: Cross-Metric Correlation
novel_features.description: Pearson correlation plus best-lag scan between any two daily metrics (steps vs resting HR, sleep vs HRV) over locally synced history
novel_features.rationale: Cross-data-type correlation is the one capability even garmy and oura-cli lack; no Google Health tool offers it

novel_features.name: Local SQLite Sync
novel_features.description: Mirror Google Health data points across data types into a local SQLite store for offline analysis
novel_features.rationale: The only third-party Google Health tool is a live-read MCP bridge with no durable datastore; Google's SDKs are stateless

novel_features.name: Full-Text Search
novel_features.description: FTS5 full-text search across locally synced Google Health records
novel_features.rationale: Requires the local SQLite index; not offered by any Google Health tool or SDK
